item.summary: Moody's Ratings and Chainlink on 10 November 2026 announced that they had completed a pilot of distributing credit-ratings information across multiple blockchain networks using Chainlink's Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol and Moody's Token Integration Engine. The companies say the pilot used representative test data in a controlled environment; no live ratings were published on-chain, and no live rating-dissemination processes were involved. According to the announcement, any future production workflow would follow Moody's established publication processes.
